items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: So Arthur Whetsol and Tricky Sam and myself, we were the trio.

ctx.x: What did they do to you?

They put a toothpick under the keys on my clarinet and then when I started to pick it up to blow and nothing come out. And we did it to Hodges, did it to -- we did everybody. Everybody had -- Tizol, we played the -- we played a theater in Philadelphia -- I can't think of the name of it. Well, anyway, it's a small stage and in those days they was using klieg lights, you know. And Tizol was up on the ramp above right by the klieg lights and on the opposite side I was next to a klieg light, too, burning up like…
